Vendored so bootstrap does not fetch GitHub.

- `voxprint_common-0.2.6-py3-none-any.whl`: the official v0.2.6 release asset from https://github.com/Mitroshenkov87/voxprint-common/releases/download/v0.2.6/voxprint_common-0.2.6-py3-none-any.whl (tag commit 75860fb6d786a6a99c0ea5fa746a350372856b11; sha256 `aeb2b180025967a02a81e206dfa0dd01c3d77a2aa20447485288496123851505`, also in the `.sha256` sidecar). It bundles the serial 9 signed model index (index head 15edeab, sha256 104742f9…f49e45f) and our index public key (`keys/index-public.pem`). CI, docs, release builds and the Windows setup install it. The `gui` extra pins `voxprint-common[ui]==0.2.6`.
